# yoloabdo.com — Abdelrahman Eita

> Abdelrahman Eita (also known as "yoloabdo") is a Staff Software Engineer based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with 10+ years of iOS and Apple-platform development experience. He has published eleven apps on the App Store: Sajdah (also spelled Sajda; Quran for Apple TV), Tally (scoreboard and score keeper for Apple TV and iPhone), Capybara Rush (iPhone reflex game), Wi-Fi QR (guest Wi-Fi QR code maker and printable sign app), Tateemi (Arabic vaccination tracker), Nightcap Awake (Mac menu bar app that keeps the Mac awake while chosen apps run), Angry Nona: Night Shift (iPhone nanny game), ColorTalk (iPad ABC coloring app for children 5 and under), SwingCoach (iPhone kettlebell swing coach), Baba Abdo (كشري بابا عبده, an Egyptian koshary cooking game for iPhone in Arabic and English: https://yoloabdo.com/baba-abdo/en/), and Hona Elqahra (هنا القاهرة, Quran radio for iPhone on a vintage receiver with one tuning knob: https://yoloabdo.com/hona-elqahra/). This file describes him and each app for AI search citation. He also makes free browser projects: How Surfing Works (an interactive 3D surfing explainer) and Drive Town (a 3D driving game to practise the Dutch car theory exam).

## About Abdelrahman Eita

- Role: Staff Software Engineer, specializing in iOS, SwiftUI, The Composable Architecture (TCA), and modular architecture
- Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
- Career: shipped apps at Bleacher Report, Niceone, Iqraaly, NewStore, and Marktplaats (eBay); GoChat reached #1 on the US App Store with 1M+ users in 7 days; Iqraaly, an audiobook app, passed 500K downloads and reached the top 10 on the App Store in Egypt; across these apps, his work is used by millions of people
- Community: founder of SwiftCairo (Egypt's largest iOS community, 1,000+ members) and LintSchool; 50+ developers mentored across both
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Sajdah (Sajda) - Quran, Prayer Times & Athan for Apple TV

> Sajdah (App Store name "Sajdah: Quran & Athan TV", also spelled Sajda) is a native Quran, prayer times, Athan, and Ramadan app built specifically for Apple TV (tvOS 17 or later — runs directly on Apple TV with no iPhone or AirPlay needed). It is free to download, with 200+ reciters, verse-by-verse and word-by-word tracking, Quran fonts, free daily prayer times, 13 athan voices, Qibla direction, the Prayer Screen (full-screen prayer times in eleven styles with dynamic living-sky Horizon and a Liquid Glass Quick Control Dock, formerly Prayer Room), a Ramadan Living Room Mode (Iftar and Suhoor countdowns, the Iftar dua, a 30-day Khatmah and Live Makkah Taraweeh), Family Hifz, Playlists, Quick Tafsir (Al-Muyassar), morning and evening adhkar, the verse and hadith of the day, Quran radio, live Islamic TV including Makkah, and Top Shelf cards on the Apple TV Home Screen.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/)
- Languages: [English](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/) · [العربية](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/ar/) · [Türkçe](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/tr/) · [Français](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/fr/) · [Español](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/es/) · [اردو](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/ur/) · [বাংলা](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/bn/) · [Bahasa Indonesia](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/id/) · [Русский](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/ru/) · [Svenska](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/sv/) · [中文](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/zh/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759179587)
- [The Prayer Screen on Apple TV](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-prayer-screen-apple-tv/): all eleven full-screen Prayer Screen styles (Classic, Focus, Horizon, Timetable, Rosette, Board, Masjid, Sanctuary, Mihrab, Chronograph, Ayat), the Liquid Glass Quick Control Dock, dynamic living-sky Horizon (free), Arabic layout, and OLED burn-in protection
- [Tracing every ayah and word](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-ayah-word-tracking/): how verse-by-verse and word-by-word tracking works, seven problems (edition mismatch, one reciter's timing for all, repeats, rejected data, a CDN move, late answers), coverage today (six recordings with word timing) and next steps (forced alignment, a listening test)
- [Sajdah 2.0 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-2-0-release-notes/): Ramadan 1448 Living Room Mode, free five daily prayers and Horizon Prayer Screen (6 styles total in the submitted 2.0 build; 5 extra styles and Quick Control Dock planned for a follow-up update), Family Hifz, Playlists, Juz 1-30 jump, Quick Tafsir, Adhkar Auto-Pace, and 60-second daily Radio and Live TV previews
- [Sajdah 1.7.0 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-1-7-0-release-notes/): choose your city, 15 calculation methods with a preview of today's times, Standard or Hanafi Asr, a short-night rule above 48°, and each prayer adjusted up to 30 minutes (all Premium)
- [Sajdah 1.7.4 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-1-7-4-release-notes/): a preview of the Premium feature you pick, scenic backgrounds, Khatmah, surah search, and Quran Radio and prayer-time fixes
- [Sajdah 1.7.3 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-1-7-3-release-notes/): lifetime Premium as a one-time purchase, and the radio, Athan and prayer-time fixes in 1.7.1 to 1.7.3
- [Sajdah 1.6.0 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-1-6-0-release-notes/): a new Today screen, the Prayer Screen in six Premium styles with a free preview, the Athan in 13 voices (Premium), new Adhkar art, a What's New screen
- [Sajdah 1.5.0 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/sajdah-1-5-0-release-notes/)
- [The best Quran apps for Apple TV, compared (2026)](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/quran-apps-apple-tv-compared/): nine Quran apps that run on Apple TV, compared on the TV experience, with sources
- [The journey so far: building Sajdah for Apple TV](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/building-sajdah-apple-tv-journey/)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/support/) · [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/privacy/) · [Privacy Policy in Arabic](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/privacy/ar/)

## Key Features

- **200+ Quran Reciters** with multiple narrations (Hafs, Warsh, and others)
- **Verse-by-Verse Sync** with precise ayah tracking, and **word-by-word highlighting** on selected Hafs reciters (premium)
- **Quran Fonts**: Uthmanic (free), plus Amiri, Scheherazade New, Noto Naskh, KFGQPC Nastaleeq and Lateef (premium)
- **Live Tab**: Quran radio stations with a live equalizer and live Islamic TV channels, including Makkah (premium; since 2.0 everyone gets a free 60-second daily preview of Radio and of Live TV)
- **Today** (free): the verse of the day at the center, the next prayer in a one-line prayer bar, and short cards for continue listening, Adhkar and the hadith of the day in the app language
- **Morning and Evening Adhkar** with a Siri Remote counter, or hands-free with Auto-Pace (new in 2.0)
- **Ramadan Living Room Mode** (new in 2.0, free): Iftar and Suhoor countdowns on Today, Top Shelf and the Horizon Prayer Screen, the authentic Iftar dua in the last 10 minutes before Maghrib, a one-press 30-day Ramadan Khatmah (one Juz a day), Live Makkah Taraweeh pinned on Ramadan evenings, and a Hijri date adjustment of -2 to +2 days for local moon sighting
- **Family Hifz** (new in 2.0, free): listen-and-repeat memorization for the whole family across all 114 surahs, started from Today
- **Playlists, Juz jump and Quick Tafsir** (new in 2.0): play curated starter playlists (Friday Al-Kahf, Before Sleep, Ruqyah) and saved playlists read-only for free (creating, adding to, and editing custom playlists requires Sajdah Premium); Juz 1-30 filter in surah selection and Tafsir Al-Muyassar / English explanation in the player (Hafs recordings) are free
- **Prayer Times** for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha in the location's time zone (free since 2.0), **13 Athan voices** plus a Fajr Athan, and **Qibla Direction** (premium)
- **Prayer time settings** (premium, new in 1.7.0): search any city or keep Automatic, 15 calculation methods with a preview of today's times, Standard or Hanafi Asr, a short-night rule for cities above 48° latitude, and an adjustment of up to 30 minutes for each prayer. The Athan, the Prayer Screen and Top Shelf follow these settings
- **Prayer Screen** (formerly Prayer Room): full-screen prayer times that stay on the TV, in eleven styles (Classic, Focus, Horizon, Timetable, Rosette, Board, Masjid, Sanctuary, Mihrab, Chronograph and Ayat), with an auto-hiding Liquid Glass Quick Control Dock (direct style picker, background Quran audio, persisted 12h/24h/Auto clock format, and verse strip toggle) and OLED burn-in protection (dynamic living-sky Horizon + Quick Control Dock are free; Premium unlocks all eleven styles and Iqamah countdowns)
- **Top Shelf**: continue listening, verse of the day and next prayer on the Apple TV Home Screen
- **Player**: focus mode, ambient mode, sleep timer (15-60 min or end of surah), repeat and A-B repeat, playback speed from 0.5x to 2x, translations and optional transliteration
- **Multilingual**: English, Arabic, Turkish, French, Spanish, Urdu, Bengali, Indonesian, Russian, Swedish, and Chinese

## Pricing

- Free: Quran recitation with every reciter, verse-by-verse reading with synchronized Arabic text, one translation, surah repeat, sleep timer, the Today screen, all five daily prayer times (default calculation) with the Hijri date adjustment, the dynamic living-sky Horizon Prayer Screen with Quick Control Dock, Ramadan Living Room Mode, Family Hifz, playing starter and saved playlists (read-only), Juz 1-30 jump, Quick Tafsir, Khatmah, morning and evening Adhkar with Auto-Pace, and a 60-second daily preview of Quran Radio and Live TV
- Sajdah Premium (optional in-app subscription or one-time lifetime purchase): creating, saving and editing custom playlists, unlimited Quran radio and live TV, the Athan in 13 voices, the prayer time settings (city, calculation method, Hanafi Asr, short-night rule, minute adjustments, Iqamah offsets), Qibla direction, the Prayer Screen in all eleven styles with Iqamah countdowns, ambient mode, all translations and transliteration, word-by-word highlighting, memorization tools, playback speed, extra Quran fonts
- No ads

## Platform

- Apple TV (tvOS 17 or later)
- Requires internet connection for streaming

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Tally - iPhone Score Keeper and Apple TV Scoreboard

> Tally is a free score keeper app for iPhone and scoreboard app for Apple TV built for game nights and sports. On Apple TV it supports 6 sports plus Game Night mode for 2-8 players, with giant room-readable scores, timers, live score tracking, turn markers, undo, and a big-screen winner reveal. On iPhone (added in version 1.6), Tally offers Game Night, a two-team Scoreboard, a chess clock, game types for Card Game 500, Word Game, Rummy 500, Hearts, Darts 501 and Cornhole, and a house leaderboard synced with iCloud. Sports on Apple TV include basketball, soccer, tennis, ping pong, volleyball, and a generic custom mode. Game Night mode supports Running Total, Rounds Won, and Lives. Since version 1.3.2 (28 August 2026), every feature is free, with no subscriptions, in-app purchases, or ads. Version 1.3.2 sends no analytics. From version 1.3.3, the app sends usage analytics and crash reports to Google Firebase.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/tally/)
- [Trailer](https://yoloabdo.com/media/tally/tally-v13-promo-1080.mp4)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tally-game-night-scoreboard/id6760623633)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/tally/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/tally/privacy/)
- [Tally 1.6 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/score-keeper-app-iphone-apple-tv/): iPhone app with iCloud sync, a house leaderboard, a chess clock, and game types for Rummy 500, Hearts, Darts 501 and Cornhole
- [Tally 1.3.2 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/tally-1-3-2-release-notes/): Tally is now fully free; every sport and Game Night unlocked; no analytics

## Key Features

- **6 Sports + Game Night** — Basketball (quarters, 1/2/3-point), Soccer (halves, stoppage time), Tennis (game/set/match, deuce/advantage, tiebreaks), Ping Pong (best of 5, serve rotation), Volleyball (rally-point, final set to 15), Generic (custom). Game Night mode: 2-8 players, three scoring models (Running Total, Rounds Won, Lives), turn marker, MVP badge, Play Again
- **Giant Scores** — 220pt typography readable from across the room
- **Live Score Tracking + Timers** — Countdown (basketball), countup (soccer), buzzer on expiration, and quick score updates on the big screen
- **Full Undo** — Revert any scoring action, up to 20 steps back
- **Custom Team Names** — Set before each game, saved automatically
- **Dark & Light Mode** — Follows Apple TV appearance, OLED-friendly
- **Controls Overlay** — Press Menu for undo, point values, timer controls, end game
- **Audio Feedback** — Score sounds, timer buzzer, game over fanfare
- **VoiceOver** — Full accessibility with score announcements
- **Onboarding** — First-launch walkthrough for Siri Remote controls

## Pricing

- Completely free since version 1.3.2 (28 August 2026)
- No subscriptions, in-app purchases, paywalls, or ads
- From version 1.3.3, the app sends usage analytics and crash reports to Google Firebase

## Platform

- iPhone (iOS 17+) and Apple TV 4K / Apple TV HD (tvOS 17+)
- Saved players and finished games sync between devices with iCloud; core scoring works offline

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Capybara Rush: Swipe Fast - Cozy iPhone Reflex Game

> Capybara Rush: Swipe Fast is a cozy iPhone reflex game built for quick 30-second rounds. Players read prompts, swipe in the correct direction, keep combos alive, trigger Fever Rush, grab golden bonuses, earn coins, unlock capybara skins, and compare high scores with Game Center. It works offline and includes no ads, no tracking, and no account requirement.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/capybara-rush/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/capybara-rush-swipe-fast/id6766263673)
- [Capybara Rush 1.5 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/capybara-rush-1-5-release-notes/): daily Game Center run from 21 October 2026, the Capybara Cup from 11 November to 8 December 2026, share poster, six achievements
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/capybara-rush/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/capybara-rush/privacy/)

## Key Features

- **30-Second Swipe Rounds** — quick one-thumb arcade sessions
- **Prompt Twists** — normal prompts, fake prompts, and opposite prompts
- **Fever Rush** — strong runs fill a meter and shift into faster scoring
- **Golden Bonuses** — special moments worth more score and coins
- **Unlockable Skins** — Sleepy, Strawberry, Sunglasses, Wizard, Space, and Golden capybara styles
- **Game Center** — leaderboard support for high scores
- **Offline Friendly** — progress, coins, best score, skins, tutorial state, and settings are stored locally
- **Privacy-First** — no ads, no tracking, no account, and no personal data collection

## Pricing

- Free
- No ads

## Platform

- iOS (iPhone), requires iOS 17+
- Works fully offline; Game Center leaderboard features use Apple's Game Center services

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Wi-Fi QR - Guest Wi-Fi QR Codes and Printable Signs

> Wi-Fi QR is a private iPhone and iPad utility for creating guest Wi-Fi QR codes, Home & Lock Screen widgets, Airbnb WiFi signs, and printable guest Wi-Fi signs. It is built for hosts, homes, cafes, offices, guest rooms, short-term rentals, VRBO stays, vacation rentals, and Airbnb-style stays. It helps people who are searching for an Airbnb WiFi sign template, WiFi QR code template, WiFi password sign, editable Canva WiFi template, Etsy WiFi QR sign, house manual WiFi instructions, welcome binder WiFi page, or guest network QR code. Version 1.9 (November 2026) adds Home & Lock Screen widgets (Pro), full-screen bright QR mode, one-tap Copy Password (2-minute auto-expiry) and Send as Text, custom QR dot patterns, auto-contrasted brand color and venue logo (Pro), and reading QR codes from router sticker photos or saved screenshots. Up to 2 saved networks are free, with 10 printable sign templates (3 free, 7 in one-time Pro) across four paper sizes, no account, no ads, and no subscription; anonymous usage events through Firebase Analytics never include Wi-Fi names, passwords or QR contents.

## Links

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6776169783)
- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/)
- [Free Browser Wi-Fi QR Code & Printable Sign Generator](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/generator/): 100% client-side, zero-signup Wi-Fi QR and printable card generator with PNG, SVG, and print export (passwords never leave the browser)
- [Airbnb WiFi sign guide](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/airbnb-wifi-sign/): what to put on an Airbnb WiFi sign or card, where to put it, which size to print, how guests scan the QR code, and how to make one with Wi-Fi QR
- [Wi-Fi QR vs Canva & Etsy templates (2026)](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/vs-canva-etsy/): pricing math and workflow comparison against Canva Pro, Etsy digital/acrylic signs, and Apple's iOS 18 Passwords app
- [How to share your Wi-Fi with a QR code on iPhone](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/share-wifi-qr-code-iphone/): three ways to share Wi-Fi from an iPhone (the Passwords app QR code in iOS 18, Share Password for nearby Apple devices, and a printable code from Wi-Fi QR), how guests scan, and fixes for codes that do not work
- [The story behind Wi-Fi QR](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/wifi-qr-story/): why the app exists, from a hotel Wi-Fi card in London to the App Store in four days, built with Codex
- [Wi-Fi QR 1.9 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/wifi-qr-1-9-release-notes/): Home & Lock Screen widgets (Pro), full-screen bright QR mode, Copy Password and Send as Text, custom QR patterns, brand color and logo (Pro), and photo QR scan
- [Wi-Fi QR 1.8 printing guide and release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/print-wifi-qr-code-sign-iphone/): printing a guest sign or 8 cut-out cards from the app, the place name, and Wi-Fi QR Pro
- [Wi-Fi QR 1.7 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/wifi-qr-1-7-release-notes/): WPA or WEP with clear checks, guest signs that fit long passwords, better router-sticker scanning
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/wifi-qr/privacy/)

## Key Features

- **Generate Guest Wi-Fi QR Codes** - create scannable codes for WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP, open, and hidden networks, with inline checks for the network name and password
- **Home & Lock Screen Widgets (Pro)** - pin a scannable QR code in small or medium size to the Home Screen or open a pinned pass from the Lock Screen
- **Full-Screen Bright QR Mode** - expand any QR pass to 100% display brightness and keep the screen awake while guests scan
- **Copy Password & Send as Text** - local-only password copy with 2-minute auto-expiry, plus plain-text Wi-Fi details for laptops and TVs
- **Custom QR Branding (Pro)** - choose from Squircle (free), Dots, Connected, and Classic Square patterns, pick an auto-contrasted (>= 6.5:1) brand color, and embed a custom venue logo
- **Printable Guest Wi-Fi Signs** - ten templates (Classic, Code Only, 8-per-page Cut-out Cards free; Gallery Placard, Concierge Ledger, Signal Grid, Ink-Safe Editorial, Keycard, Olive Branch, Arrival Folio in Pro) in 4 x 6 in, 5 x 7 in, A4 and US Letter; direct printing from the app
- **Airbnb and VRBO Host Use Cases** - create WiFi password signs for welcome binders, house manuals, check-in instructions, fridges, TV stands, desks, and router shelves
- **Template Search Replacement** - useful for people searching Etsy, Canva, or Pinterest for WiFi QR code templates and printable Airbnb WiFi signs
- **Router Sticker & Photo Scanning** - scan router-sticker text or read Wi-Fi QR codes from sticker photos and saved screenshots, including English, German, French and Arabic labels, and review before saving
- **Use Current Network Name** - with permission, reads the current Wi-Fi SSID to reduce typing
- **Manual and Hidden Networks** - supports manual SSID entry, open guest networks, and hidden-network QR codes
- **Saved Networks & Search** - save up to 2 networks free locally in Keychain (unlimited with Pro) and search saved networks quickly
- **Share QR Images and Sign PDFs** - exports QR images and printable guest signs through the iOS share sheet
- **Privacy** - no accounts, ads or cross-app tracking; saved networks stay on the device; anonymous usage events (Firebase Analytics) never include Wi-Fi names, passwords, QR contents, scanned text or sign text

## Pricing

- Free (up to 2 saved networks, unlimited QR generation, bright full-screen mode, Copy Password, Send as Text, direct printing, 3 templates)
- No ads and no subscription
- Wi-Fi QR Pro: optional one-time unlock for widgets, unlimited saved networks, custom QR dot patterns/brand color/logo, 7 extra templates, 3 extra themes, and removing the app link from Classic signs

## Platform

- iOS 17+ for iPhone and iPad
- Works offline for saved/manual networks; current Wi-Fi name detection uses iOS location permission

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# تطعيمي (Tateemi) - Vaccination Tracker

> Tateemi is a free-to-download Arabic vaccination tracker for iPhone with country-based child immunization schedules. Parents choose the supported country schedule, add a child with their birth date, and the app calculates upcoming doses, tracks vaccination progress, sends smart reminders, provides medical information for each vaccine, supports multiple children, and stores all data locally on-device only.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/tateemi/)
- [English Page](https://yoloabdo.com/tateemi/en/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tateemi-baby-vaccine-tracker/id6760822504)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/tateemi/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/tateemi/privacy/)

## Key Features

- **Country-Based Schedules** with dose timelines calculated from the child's birth date
- **Vaccination Progress Tracking** with visual completion percentage for each child
- **Smart Reminders** — notifications 1 week, 3 days, and on the day of each upcoming dose
- **Medical Information** for each vaccine: what it is, why it matters, and possible side effects
- **Multiple Children Support** — track all your children's vaccinations in one place
- **Offline / Local Data Only** — the child's records stay on the device and no account is needed; optional anonymous analytics (with consent) and crash reports

## Pricing

- Free to download, with no ads; the first child is free, and Tateemi Pro (a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase) adds more children

## Platform

- iOS (iPhone), requires iOS 17+
- Works fully offline — no internet required

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Nightcap Awake - Keep Your Mac Awake While Apps Run

> Nightcap Awake (also called Nightcap) is a free menu bar app for Mac. It keeps the Mac awake only while the apps you choose are running, such as Codex, Ghostty, Xcode or Terminal, and lets the Mac sleep again when they quit. It is made for AI coding agents, builds, exports, uploads and command-line sessions. While a watched app runs, it holds a macOS power assertion against idle system sleep; when the last watched app quits, it releases the assertion. The display can still turn off. Version 1.0 came out in May 2026. Free on the Mac App Store, open source under the MIT license, sandboxed, with no analytics and no network access.

## Links

- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6769450957)
- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/nightcap-awake/)
- [Nightcap Awake vs Amphetamine, KeepingYouAwake & caffeinate (2026)](https://yoloabdo.com/nightcap-awake/vs-amphetamine/): side-by-side comparison of open-source auditability, App Sandbox, triggers, and closed-lid trade-offs
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/Abdo-codes/Nightcap)
- [Support (GitHub issues)](https://github.com/Abdo-codes/Nightcap/issues)
- [Privacy Policy](https://github.com/Abdo-codes/Nightcap/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)

## Key Features

- **App-Based Awake Rules** - add any app; while one watched app runs, the Mac does not go to idle sleep
- **Automatic Release** - when the last watched app quits, Nightcap releases the hold and the Mac sleeps on its normal schedule
- **Menu Bar Only** - a cup icon fills while the Mac is kept awake, the menu shows how many watched apps are active, and there is no Dock icon
- **Pause and Resume** - keep an app in the list without keeping the Mac awake, then resume or remove it from the same menu
- **Sleep and Wake Check** - after wake, Nightcap checks again which watched apps still run
- **Launch at Login** - starts with the Mac
- **Privacy** - sandboxed, no analytics and no network access; the watched-app list is one local file in the app sandbox

## Pricing

- Free
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases

## Platform

- macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Also available with Homebrew: `brew install --cask Abdo-codes/tap/nightcap`

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Angry Nona: Night Shift - Cozy iPhone Nanny Game

> Angry Nona: Night Shift is a cozy iPhone game (version 1.7, November 2026). Six toddlers. One nanny. The player keeps a nursery asleep from 9 PM until dawn: shh kids who stir, fetch the bottle, teddy, or story they ask for, queue several taps in a row, do chores in quiet moments, and keep Princess Nona from waking the room. Version 1.7 makes Night 1 a 60-second shh-only first shift, trims Nights 2 and 3 to 75 seconds each, adds title-screen Nanny shop hints, and polishes audio, haptics, VoiceOver, and Dynamic Type. It has 25 nights plus Endless (Nights 1-4 free; one Full Shift purchase unlocks Nights 5-25, Endless, and the Dawn medal), a Nanny shop that runs on points earned in play, and nanny outfits. No ads and no tracking. It is free on the App Store.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/angry-nona/)
- [Arabic landing page (سكّت النونة)](https://yoloabdo.com/angry-nona/ar/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/angry-nona-night-shift/id6819626561)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/angry-nona/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/angry-nona/privacy/)
- [Launch post](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/angry-nona-night-shift-launch/): what the game is, how a night plays, and what is free
- [1.5 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/angry-nona-1-5-release-notes/): what is in Topsy-Turvy Week (Nights 20 to 25), the Daily Night share grid and sound on silent
- [1.6 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/angry-nona-1-6-release-notes/): streak rewards for the Daily Night, friends today, a new text from Mom each day and Arabic Game Center achievements
- [1.7 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/angry-nona-1-7-release-notes/): 60-second shh-only Night 1, 75-second Nights 2 and 3, title-screen Nanny shop hints, and audio, haptics, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type polish

## Key Features

- **Six Toddlers, One Nanny** - keep every crib asleep through the night shift
- **Shh and Fetch** - read each kid's bubble; shh them, or bring a bottle, a teddy, or a story
- **Tap Queue** - tap several cribs in a row and the nanny serves them one by one
- **Chores in Quiet Moments** - warm a bottle, crochet a teddy, or water the plant
- **Coffee** - keeps the nanny going on long nights
- **Mom's Calls** - decline fast, or the phone rings in the nursery
- **Princess Nona** - the ringleader with a crown; if she wakes, the room can follow
- **25 Nights + Endless** - nights add kids and twists, then Endless for high scores. Nights 1-4 free; Full Shift unlocks the rest
- **Nanny Shop** - spend points earned in play on helps and new looks
- **Outfits** - dress the nanny in new looks
- **Accessibility** - VoiceOver and Reduce Motion support
- **Privacy-First** - no ads, no tracking, no account; only anonymous game stats and crash reports

## Availability

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/angry-nona-night-shift/id6819626561
- Free download; Nights 1-4 are free, and one Full Shift in-app purchase unlocks the rest

## Platform

- iOS (iPhone), requires iOS 18+
- Plays fully offline; progress, settings, and points are stored on the device

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# ColorTalk: ABC & 123 Coloring - Letters and Numbers for Kids on iPad

> ColorTalk is an ABC and 123 coloring app for iPad that teaches children 5 and under the English alphabet, numbers 1 to 10, Arabic letters, and 20 dinosaurs. Home is a bookshelf with four tactile open picture books: Letters, Numbers, Arabic Letters and Dinosaurs. In version 1.2.1 (November 2026), all four books open as real two-page spreads showing the child's own colored artwork, every finished dinosaur comes alive in its prehistoric habitat with a discovery fact and gentle storybook adventure, and parents can print colored or blank pages from all four books via AirPrint. It works offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. ColorTalk sends only anonymous usage counts (since version 1.1) and no crash reports. It has no in-app purchases and no external links in the child flow. It is free on the App Store.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/colortalk/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/colortalk-abc-123-coloring/id6768992579)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/colortalk/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/colortalk/privacy/)
- [Launch post](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/colortalk-abc-coloring-launch/): how a letter page works, who it is for, and the privacy promise
- [1.2.1 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/colortalk-1-2-1-release-notes/): tactile open picture books across all four books, 20 living dinosaurs in prehistoric habitats with storybook adventures, Lumo canvas cheering, and 4-book AirPrint printing
- [1.2 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/colortalk-1-2-release-notes/): the Dinosaurs book, the Arabic letters book, color by number for 3 to 5, Glow, My Art frames and screens in Arabic, German and French
- [1.1 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/colortalk-1-1-release-notes/): the Numbers book (1 to 10), the sparkle tool, letter sounds, printing and Dutch screens

## Key Features

- **Four Open Picture Books** - Letters (A to Z), Numbers (1 to 10), Arabic Letters (28 letters, right-to-left), and Dinosaurs (20 dinosaurs) all flip as two-page spreads showing the child's colored pages
- **20 Living Dinosaurs** - finished dinosaurs come alive in prehistoric habitats with walking gaits, wildlife calls, discovery facts in all 6 UI languages, and gentle storybook adventures with felt keepsakes
- **Numbers 1 to 10** - each number page has that many things to color ("3. Three ducks!"); the child traces the number, counts along, then finds it
- **One Letter, One Word** - each page teaches one letter and one word, such as "C is for cow"
- **Coloring First** - coloring is the main activity; Glow, Sparkle, undoable clear, and Lumo cheering beside the canvas support the art
- **Lumo the Firefly** - says the letters, words, and prompts in recorded English voice clips; spoken prompts are off by default, and a parent can preview and turn them on in Settings
- **Parents Area** - behind a grown-up math gate; holds progress across all 4 books, today's play time, 4-book AirPrint printing, and Settings
- **Works Offline** - all pages, words, and prompts are bundled in the app
- **Privacy** - No ads, no accounts, no tracking. ColorTalk sends only anonymous usage counts (since version 1.1) and no crash reports. Optional voice answers (off by default) use on-device speech recognition and save no audio

## Availability

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/colortalk-abc-123-coloring/id6768992579
- Free, with no in-app purchases
- Kids category, ages 5 and under

## Platform

- iPadOS (iPad), landscape orientation
- App screens in English, Dutch, Arabic, German and French; the ABC book and Lumo's voice are in English; includes an Arabic letters book (28 letters) and Dinosaurs book (20 dinosaurs) since version 1.2

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# SwingCoach: Kettlebell Workout - Kettlebell Swing Rep Counter and Form Check for iPhone

> SwingCoach is a kettlebell workout app for the Russian swing. The iPhone camera counts each rep and checks your form. When a fault repeats, a short spoken cue tells you what to fix. It starts you with a five-swing form check and a three-session starter plan. An Apple Watch app is optional. Free, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Pose analysis runs on the iPhone. From 1.2.1, you can opt in to silent workout recordings that stay on your iPhone unless you share them. SwingCoach does not upload camera footage. It is free on the App Store.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/swingcoach/)
- [vs Kettlebell Apps (Comparison)](https://yoloabdo.com/swingcoach/vs-kettlebell-apps/): honest comparison of SwingCoach (camera pose) vs pocket accelerometer apps (OmniSwing), Apple Watch apps (BELLr), and interval timers
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swingcoach-kettlebell-workout/id6806616079)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/swingcoach/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/swingcoach/privacy/)
- [Launch post](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/swingcoach-kettlebell-swing-counter-launch/): why I built it, why a phone app, and how the Apple Watch helps
- [1.2.1 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/swingcoach-1-2-1-release-notes/): daily swing challenges of 50, 100 or 200 swings a day, a daily reminder, and better rep counting, rep review and Apple Watch controls
- [1.2 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/kettlebell-workout-app-hands-free/): the 1.2 dark look with one big number, the hands-free end, round workout results and Skip rest
- [1.1 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/swingcoach-1-1-release-notes/): the hands-free start, spoken cues and rest, the big rep count, Apple Watch changes, the 1.1.1 fixes and the Firebase analytics change

## Key Features

- **Live Rep Count** - the camera finds your hips, knees and arms and counts each swing; fix the count with one tap
- **Spoken Form Cues** - a short cue when a fault repeats
- **Five-Swing Check** - one clear place to focus and a three-session starter plan
- **Train Your Way** - open training, or a rep goal of 10, 20, 30, 50 or your own count
- **Rep Review** - the deepest hinge and the final lockout of each rep, with hip, knee and arm angles, plus History
- **Apple Watch, Optional** - heart rate, active calories, workout control and Apple Health

## Availability

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swingcoach-kettlebell-workout/id6806616079
- Free, with no in-app purchases

## Platform

- iOS (iPhone), requires iOS 17+; the optional Apple Watch app needs watchOS 10+

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Hona Elqahra (هنا القاهرة) - Quran Radio App for iPhone (v1.2)

> Hona Elqahra (هنا القاهرة, meaning "This is Cairo") is a free, ad-free Quran radio app for iPhone (iOS 18+) designed as a warm walnut and champagne-brass receiver with one tuning knob. Tap the knob to play or pause, and turn it across six saved station presets: Cairo Quran Radio (إذاعة القرآن الكريم من القاهرة), Saudi Quran Radio, Mishary Alafasy, Mahmoud Al-Husary, Abdulbasit Abdulsamad, and Mohamed Al-Minshawi. The bundled catalog contains 178 live stations (2 national broadcasts, 137 reciter and Surah Al-Baqarah streams, 4 tafsir streams, 3 adhkar and Sharia ruqyah streams, 10 Islamic programs, and 22 Quran translation streams across 18 languages) with diacritic-insensitive Arabic and phonetic English search across 10 recitation styles (Warsh, Mujawwad, Qalun, Khalaf, As-Susi, Ad-Duri, etc.). Version 1.2 adds Lock Screen, StandBy, and Dynamic Island Live Activities alongside small and wide Home Screen widgets, Siri and Shortcuts, a 15-90 minute sleep timer, AirPlay, stream failover, and opt-in only analytics. Free with no ads, no subscriptions, and no account.

## Links

- [Landing Page (English)](https://yoloabdo.com/hona-elqahra/)
- [Landing Page (Arabic — هنا القاهرة)](https://yoloabdo.com/hona-elqahra/ar/)
- [All 178 Stations Directory (English)](https://yoloabdo.com/hona-elqahra/stations/)
- [All 178 Stations Directory (Arabic)](https://yoloabdo.com/hona-elqahra/ar/stations/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hona-elqahra-quran-radio/id6831580861)
- [1.2 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/hona-elqahra-1-2-release-notes/): Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activities, 6-preset switching, and stream failover
- [1.1 release notes](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/hona-elqahra-1-1-release-notes/): Home Screen widgets with six presets, Siri and Shortcuts, station search and sleep timer
- [Launch post](https://yoloabdo.com/blog/quran-radio-app-iphone-hona-elqahra/): how the vintage receiver and one-knob dial were designed
- [Privacy Policy](https://hona-elqahra.web.app/privacy)

## Key Features

- **Vintage One-Knob Dial** - tap to play or pause, turn to switch across six customizable station presets with haptic detents and soft tuning hiss
- **178 Live Quran Stations** - Cairo Quran Radio, Saudi Quran Radio, 135+ reciters, 10 searchable riwayat, 4 tafsir, 3 adhkar/ruqyah, 10 Islamic programs, and 22 translations in 18 languages
- **Live Activities (1.2)** - Lock Screen, StandBy, and Dynamic Island Live Activity with ON AIR/TUNING/BUFFERING status, round play/pause button, and 6 preset buttons
- **Home Screen Widgets, Siri & Shortcuts (1.1)** - small pinned-station widget and wide 6-preset receiver widget plus Siri voice commands and Shortcuts actions
- **Sleep Timer, AirPlay & Stream Failover** - 15, 30, 45, 60, and 90 minute sleep timer, AirPlay, lock-screen controls, and primary/backup stream failover
- **Bilingual & Private** - full Arabic and English layouts, no account required, favorites and presets stored on-device, optional analytics and crash reports off by default

## Pricing

- Free, with zero ads, zero subscriptions, and zero in-app purchases

## Platform

- iOS (iPhone only, portrait), requires iOS 18 or later (for Apple TV Quran radio, see Sajdah)
- Station list works offline for browsing; live audio streaming requires an internet connection

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com

# Baba Abdo (كشري بابا عبده) - Egyptian Koshary Cooking Game for iPhone

> Baba Abdo (كشري بابا عبده) is a free Egyptian koshary cooking game for iPhone, played in Egyptian Arabic (landscape orientation). Run a neighborhood koshary shop through a seven-day story with 16 neighbors, listen to each customer's exact order (rice, pasta, lentils, chickpeas, tomato sauce, fried onions, garlic vinegar and chili), build the bowl in layers, ring the service bell, spend earned in-game coins to decorate the shop, and unlock untimed Practice mode after week one. Version 1.0 includes Daily Orders, Game Center leaderboards and achievements, eight stickers, and a 50% extra-time accessibility setting. Free with no ads, no tracking, no analytics and no account required.

## Key Features

- **Seven-Day Story & 16 Neighbors** - neighborhood regulars with custom orders and dialogue in Egyptian Arabic
- **Layered Koshary Bowl Gameplay** - assemble rice, pasta, lentils, chickpeas, sauce, onions and condiments; hold any ticket to pause the timer and read the order
- **Shop Decoration & Untimed Practice** - spend in-game shift earnings on shop furnishings (no real money); unlock untimed practice after the 7-day story
- **Daily Orders, Stickers & Game Center** - daily orders, eight stickers, optional Game Center scores and achievements
- **Accessibility & Privacy** - 50% extra-time mode, reduced motion support, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, local save on device

## Pricing

# How Surfing Works - Interactive 3D Explainer

> How Surfing Works is a free, interactive 3D explainer by Abdelrahman Eita that runs in the browser. It covers where waves come from, why they break, the anatomy of a wave, beach, point and reef breaks, how to read a surf report, how to ride a wave, when to pop up, and surf safety including rip currents. Visitors can watch it as a short film, change the wind and seabed, try a pop-up timing game, and record a video.

## Links

- [How Surfing Works](https://yoloabdo.com/surfing/)

# Drive Town - Dutch Car Theory Exam Practice in 3D

> Drive Town is a free 3D driving game by Abdelrahman Eita for learners who prepare for the Dutch car theory exam (CBR theorie-examen auto, category B). It runs in the browser on desktop and phone. The player drives a learner car through a small Dutch town with assisted steering and decides the speed, the indicators, when to wait, when to merge and when to overtake. It has 24 lessons in 7 chapters, a mock exam in the current CBR format (50 questions in 30 minutes, with a pass at 44), a hazard-perception practice and Dutch exam terms. It is an independent practice project and is not made by or linked to CBR.

## Links

- [Play Drive Town](https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/)
- [Exam guide and Dutch terms](https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/guide/)
- [3D artwork credits](https://yoloabdo.com/drive-town/credits.html)

## Key Features

- **24 driving lessons in 7 chapters** — Bakery run (speed, priority from the right, zebra crossings, cyclists, parking), Signs & signals (traffic lights, STOP, shark teeth and signed priority, a changing speed limit), Sharing the road (buses leaving a stop, narrow roads, railway crossings), Roundabouts (entering, signalling out, cyclists on the cycle path), Merging (zipper merge, joining from an acceleration lane, making room), Lights & sirens (amber light, emergency vehicles, police instructions), Trams & bikes (trams, cycle lanes, overtaking)
- **Mock exam** — 50 questions in 30 minutes with a pass at 44, like the CBR car theory exam since 7 April 2025. Six question types: Ja/Nee, multiple choice, multiple response, number, tap a marker in a picture, and put in order. Picture questions play a short 3D clip and stop at the key moment. The screen uses the exam terms Vraag x van y, Resterende tijd, Markeren and Overzicht. The bank has 193 original questions in eight exam topics, each with an explanation and an official source
- **Hazard practice** — 61 short 3D clips, 25 per run, with the answers Brake, Release accelerator or Do nothing. It is based on the former CBR hazard-perception part (gevaarherkenning, used until 6 April 2025)
- **Feedback and replay** — every lesson ends with a rule check; a mistake shows the recorded speed and position, with a replay of the decision moment
- **Weak topics** — mistakes from the mock exam, the hazard practice and the lessons are counted per topic. On the result, "Practise lessons" (mock exam) or "Practise this" (hazard test) opens the matching lesson, and "Hazard clips" opens its clips
- **Dutch exam terms** — 115 words such as voorrang verlenen (give way), haaientanden (shark teeth), ritsen (zipper merge) and invoegen (merging in), shown next to the English
- **Guided and Independent modes** — coach prompts, or varied traffic with no safety hints

## Pricing

- Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases

## Platform

- Any modern browser with WebGL, on desktop and phone
- Interface in English, with Dutch exam terms
- Game progress is saved only in the browser. The published page counts visits with Google Analytics, like the rest of this site

## Limits

- Practice only: a mock exam result does not predict a real exam result
- Rules link to the Dutch traffic law (RVV 1990) and other official sources. A driving instructor has not yet reviewed every question and clip
- Drive Town is not made by, endorsed by or linked to CBR

## Developer

- Built by Abdelrahman Eita
- Contact: abdulrhman.eaita@gmail.com
